about: End-of-session texts from src/renderer/viewer/reasons.js. describeClose covers every reason the module has a case for, with and without a context ({host, user, hadVideo?, passwordSet?, message?}); icon is a desktop icon name. hostReasons: host bye reasons that replace "host-ended" (effectiveCloseReason). Regenerate with node scripts/make-mobile-fixtures.js.

controlBlockReason.about: controlBlockReason(state) -> why remote control is unavailable, the end of "View only - ..."; "" = available.

cases.result: the host turned remote control off
input isn't available on the remote device

describeClose.about: describeClose(reason, ctx) -> {tone, icon, title, message, detail?}. detail: "" = the message says it all (no detail line); absent = show main's status message as detail.
